description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Foreign Exchange (Investments in Colombo Ports City) Regulation No. 01 of 2022
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Finance under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, specifically establishing the Foreign Exchange (Investments in Colombo Port City) Regulations No. 1 of 2022. The content focuses on creating new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for foreign investments in the Colombo Port City, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
